notes.title: NEWS: Patch 1.3a, Limited Printed Artbook, Nintendo Switch Release
notes.notes:
Howdy Cowboys!

First off, we have released the [b]Patch 1.3a[/b] that includes couple of small fixes in various levels as well as some fixes to the combat UI. Should you by any chance still stumble upon some bug that has not been addressed yet, feel free to shoot us an email at howdy@bloodwillbespilled.com or take a look at this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/880300/discussions/0/1640912759107156210/]thread[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32948116/07759613e32a4d31b09af38af1a410200dd5e86a.png[/img]

In other news, we have [b]a limited printed version of our artbook[/b]. Watch our [url=https://twitter.com/blwbs]Twitter[/url] to get a chance to win a limited signed copy. In case you'd be interested in a digital version, you can find it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1212880/Blood_will_be_Spilled__Artbook/]here[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1212880/Blood_will_be_Spilled__Artbook/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32948116/19a3334c186067a83f23229d7a72a7514652d545.jpg[/img]

And last but not least, our game releases on Nintendo Switch today! So if you prefer to play on the go, now you can! Thanks to our friends from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/AttuGames]Attu Games[/url] (makers of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/699670/Feudal_Alloy]Feudal Alloy[/url]), who helped us with the porting of the game, we are launching the game today on Nintendo Switch!

You can find it on the store here: https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/blood-will-be-spilled-switch/

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 1.1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, here are the patch notes for the latest patch:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with teleporting the player from one particular waypoint in final encounter in Chapter 4
[*] Fixed an issue with random teleporting after using interact in Chapter 8
[*] Fixed an issue in which opening and closing pause menu at the same time as dialogue has been triggered could make inputs not to work properly (could happen especially when skipping cutscenes followed by a dialogue)
[*] Fixed an issue with some actions of your supporting characters occasionally blocking your other inputs after use
[*] Fixed an issue with game getting stuck after finishing the boss fight in Chapter 3
[*] Fixed an issue with some triggers in Chapter 8 not triggering properly
[*] Fixed an issue with thrown dynamite not exploding while a decoy was placed somewhere in the encounter
[*] Fixed an issue with Jack’s hand sometimes flipping upside down after ledge grab in combat encounters
[*] Fixed multiple issues with smoke bomb skill
[*] Fixed an issue with reward for final boss not being properly saved
[*] From now on shootable locked platforms in Chapter 5 should now be slightly easier to hit
[*] From now on, whether you have a health potion or not will be displayed in the HUD next to your health bar
[*] From now on, during combat, you will see the number of dynamites and health potions you have displayed in the radial menu
[*] From now on, Settings can be found in the Main menu, where you can adjust the volume, screen resolution and also review the control scheme
[*] Made a small tweak to how the respawn points work 
[*] Made a small tweak to the enemy AI, so from now on, they shouldn’t try to shoot you through impenetrable platforms
[*] Some corrections in dialogue texts
[*] Multiple small fixes in multiple levels
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1 is coming next week
notes.notes:
Howdy cowboys. As you probably noticed, patches has become less frequent and we’re preparing a slightly bigger update for next week. So, what can you expect from the Patch 1.10, you ask? 
[list]
[*] Based on the feedback that we received, possession of the healing potion will be shown in the HUD next to health bar
[*] During combat encounters, the number of dynamites and healing potions that you have will be properly visually shown in the radial menu
[*] Some adjustments to the AI, which will prevent them from trying to shoot you through impenetrable platforms and obstacles
[*] Settings screen in the Main Menu, where you will be able to change resolution and adjust the volume
[*] A small tweak to how respawn works
[/list]

notes.title: Bugfixes in progress, please be patient
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
without further ado, we say it plainly: "At this point, we failed the release pretty bad!" We are making this game for 5 years already and we presented and tested it publicly many times before. We worked very hard and insane hours to meet the original release date and still made the game exactly the way we wanted. And we really thought that it's possible and we could do it without any bigger issues. We wouldn't release the game if we thought otherwise. We are inexperienced and naive.

As we are a very small team of hobby indie developers with no previous experience in game development, we have very limited resources, also our user beta testing was limited, apparently inadequate and it seems that we were not able to find (not even nearly) most of the bugs that blowed up right after the release to the public. 

We are very sorry and we apologise to everyone who already bought the game and didn't like it. It's completely understandable if you feel it didn't meet your expectations and want to issue a refund if it's still possible. Once again we are very sorry. Blood was spilled pretty bad on our side this time.
 
That being said, most of the bugs and issues is not very serious and hopefully we are able to fix them as soon as possible. Even right now we are working very hard to fix all the issues that we missed and to get the game to the appropriate state. We are going to post updates very frequently so please have your auto update enabled. 

Even if we maybe have no right to do so, we still ask for your patience and trust.

Sincerely
Doublequote studio

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32948116/d5b343ec11393ba420ec5753d0f4ccf6e2ce0953.png[/img]

notes.title: Postponing the release date
notes.notes:
Howdy cowboys! Unfortunately, we have some bad news. Due to unforeseen complications in the last days leading up the release of Blood will be Spilled, we stumbled upon few issues that made us reconsider our release date. We were really working our hardest to get it all done in time, so that we wouldn’t need to postpone the time of the release, but we’re just a very small team of three and a half people. And we didn’t want to disappoint those few fans we have by releasing the game in a state that we’re not happy with. It was a choice between two evils and we hope we chose the lesser one.

[b]So, without further ado, the new, postponed release date is on Wednesday May 29th 2019. We would really like to apologize to any people we disappointed, but we simply ask you to wait just a little bit longer. [/b]

Thank you very much for your support and hopefully see you all next week.

Sincerely,
Doublequote Studio Team
